accepted_edge_types.name: USES_PREVIOUSLY_PRODUCED_ARTIFACT
accepted_edge_types.definition: A subsequent execution command consumes, loads, or invokes an artifact (such as a source file or script) that was produced by an earlier agent action within the same trajectory.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An earlier agent action that created a persistent artifact.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A later command that loads or executes the previously created artifact.

accepted_edge_types.name: REVEALS_MISSING_PREREQUISITE
accepted_edge_types.definition: A preliminary environment probe performed by the agent returns evidence that a required tool or runtime is not available for the upcoming task.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An agent probe action that checks for the availability of a required tool or runtime.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: An observation reporting that the probed prerequisite is absent from the environment.

accepted_edge_types.name: MISSING_PREREQUISITE_CAUSES_EXECUTION_FAILURE
accepted_edge_types.definition: A later execution attempt fails to run because it depends on the same prerequisite that an earlier observation reported as missing.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An earlier observation indicating that a required prerequisite is missing.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent command execution that fails because that prerequisite is unavailable.

accepted_edge_types.name: PLANS_REMEDIATION_FOR_MISSING_PREREQUISITE
accepted_edge_types.definition: The agent's plan or decision includes a conditional follow-up step to install or obtain a prerequisite in case an availability check reveals it is missing.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: Evidence or anticipation that a required prerequisite may be missing from the environment.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: An agent plan or decision to install or obtain the missing prerequisite.
